hero.title: Three companies. One standard on the ground.
hero.subtitle: Abu Sonbul covers the road, the site and the border — cross-border trucking, everything a remote project needs to run, and getting goods through Jordan's crossings. Whichever you need, it comes from people who answer to the same name.

companies.title: Three businesses, built around what Jordan actually moves.
companies.subtitle: Each one stands on its own, with its own fleet, crews and clients. Together they cover a shipment from the loading bay to the far side of the border and out to the site.

transport.body: Cross-border trucking between Jordan and Saudi Arabia, both directions. Bulk carbonates and potash, chemicals, steel, cement and palletised goods, on an owned fleet with in-house drivers.

project-services.body: Everything a remote project needs to operate: manpower, camps, power and water, catering, housekeeping, machinery and site transport. Delivered for ADNOC and ARGAS in the Jordanian desert.

logistics.body: Getting goods across the Jaber, Tarbil, Al-Karamah and Al-Omari crossings, with forklifts and lifting equipment on station and the paperwork moving in parallel.

why.title: The operator international companies trust in Jordan.
why.badge: Trusted by ADNOC, ARGAS and other international operators.

experience.title: Three decades of leadership
experience.body: Founded in 2008 and led by a team whose transport and project experience goes back thirty years.

integrated.title: One group, three specialisms
integrated.body: Road freight, project services and border logistics under one owner — so the handover between them is an internal matter, not your problem.

regional.title: Working across four borders
regional.body: Daily operations in Jordan with freight and crews moving to and from Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Syria and the UAE.

people.title: Owned assets, employed people
people.body: Trucks, forklifts and heavy equipment we own and maintain, operated by a workforce of more than eighty on our own payroll.

home.title: Transport, Project Services & Border Logistics in Jordan
home.description: Abu Sonbul is a Jordanian group of three companies: cross-border trucking to Saudi Arabia, full services for remote project sites, and cargo handling at Jordan's border crossings. Established 2008.
